text.p: Microware Systems Corp said Tuesday that Zenith Electronics Corp will use its OS-9-based DAVIDLite system software under a licensing agreement.
Zenith said the software will be used in the digital television set-top boxes it will supply to the Americast programming venture, which will buy three million of the set-top boxes.
The software, combined with Zenith's digital devices, allows programmers flexibility to offer a broad range of services. DAVIDLite can be used in telephone, cable television and wireless networks.
Americast is a consortium of Ameritech Corp, BellSouth Corp, GTE Corp, SBC Communications Inc, Southern New England Telecommunications Corp and Walt Disney Co.
